title: Indeed company reviews
description: One row per Indeed employee review (charged), plus a free company context row and a free status row per company and country.

target.description: The input value (company name, slug or /cmp/ URL) this row came from, exactly as given

company.description: The slug Indeed files the company under, the part after /cmp/ (e.g. Google, The-Home-Depot) — also when the input was a plain name like "Home Depot"

company_name.description: Company name as Indeed displays it

country.description: Which Indeed domain the row was read on: us, all, ca, uk, de, ...

review_id.description: Indeed's stable encrypted review id, the id in the review URL

rating.description: Overall rating: 1-5 stars on review rows, Indeed's average (e.g. 4.3) on company rows

work_life_balance.description: Reviewer's 1-5 rating for work/life balance; null when they did not rate it

compensation_benefits.description: Reviewer's 1-5 rating for compensation and benefits; null when they did not rate it

job_security_advancement.description: Reviewer's 1-5 rating for job security and advancement; null when they did not rate it

management.description: Reviewer's 1-5 rating for management; null when they did not rate it

culture_values.description: Reviewer's 1-5 rating for culture; null when they did not rate it

title.description: The review headline the employee wrote

pros.description: The reviewer's Pros field, when the review was submitted with the pros/cons form

cons.description: The reviewer's Cons field, when the review was submitted with the pros/cons form

job_title.description: The reviewer's job title, e.g. "Software Engineer"

location.description: Where the reviewer worked, e.g. "Mountain View, CA"

review_country.description: ISO country code Indeed files the review under, e.g. US

review_date.description: Publication date as YYYY-MM-DD, parsed from the domain's own language

review_date_text.description: The date exactly as Indeed printed it, e.g. "August 25, 2026" or "3. September 2025"

helpful_count.description: How many people voted the review helpful

unhelpful_count.description: How many people voted the review not helpful

employer_reply.description: The employer's official public response to the review, if any

employer_reply_date.description: Date of the employer response, YYYY-MM-DD

url.description: Direct link to the review on Indeed

review_count.description: All reviews Indeed holds for the company worldwide (company rows)

found_review_count.description: Reviews this domain actually lists — the number the walk can reach (company and status rows)

histogram.description: Star histogram: how many reviews gave 1, 2, 3, 4 and 5 stars (company rows)

ratings_breakdown.description: Indeed's company averages for work_life_balance, compensation_benefits, job_security_advancement, management and culture_values (company rows)

happiness_grade.description: The band Indeed puts that score in, e.g. EXCELLENT, FAIR (company rows)

top_pros.description: The positives Indeed extracts from the review corpus (company rows)

top_cons.description: The negatives Indeed extracts from the review corpus (company rows)

topics.description: Indeed's topic breakdown: name, rating and count for work-life balance, pay and benefits, job security, management and culture (company rows)

industry.description: Industry Indeed files the company under, e.g. "Internet & Web Services" (company rows)

company_size.description: Employee range, e.g. "10,000+" or "51 to 200" (company rows)

website.description: The company's own website as Indeed lists it (company rows)

ceo.description: CEO name as Indeed lists it (company rows)

company_url.description: The company's Indeed profile page (company rows)

reviews_fetched.description: Reviews read in this run for the company before filters (company rows)

status.description: ok | no_reviews | not_found | duplicate | partial | error (status rows). partial = some reviews were delivered and charged, then Indeed refused the next page; error = nothing was delivered

reviews.description: Reviews delivered and charged for this company and country (status rows)

filtered.description: Reviews dropped by the filters, never charged (status rows)

total.description: Reviews Indeed holds for the company worldwide (status rows)

duplicates.description: 1 when this target resolved to a company another target already covers (status rows)

already_seen.description: onlyNewReviews: reviews skipped because an earlier run already delivered them — never charged (status rows)

suggestions.description: On not_found: the closest companies Indeed's own autocomplete knows, each {name, company, url} — pass one's company or url as the next input. null otherwise (status rows)

error.description: Why a company or country failed or was cut short; on not_found it lists the closest company names Indeed knows (status rows)
